description: 8-step AI-agent-driven QA pipeline using Playwright MCP and official Playwright Test Agents (planner, generator, healer)
short_trigger: Prompt for End-to-End QA Workflow with Natural.txt

required_mcp_servers.name: Playwright MCP
required_mcp_servers.description: Browser automation tools (navigation, forms, screenshots, assertions, etc.)

required_agents.name: 🎭 Playwright Test Planner
required_agents.description: Explores the app and produces a Markdown test plan

required_agents.name: 🎭 Playwright Test Generator
required_agents.description: Transforms Markdown plan into Playwright Test files

steps.name: Read User Story
steps.description: Reads the user story from user-stories/[STORY_ID].md, summarizes requirements and ACs
steps.output: Summary of user story, AC list, app URL, credentials

steps.name: Create Test Plan
steps.description: Explores the app and creates a comprehensive test plan

steps.name: Perform Exploratory Testing
steps.description: Manual step-through of each test scenario using Playwright MCP

steps.name: Generate Automation Scripts
steps.description: Creates Playwright TypeScript spec files from test plan + exploratory findings

steps.name: Execute and Heal Tests
steps.description: Runs tests, auto-heals failures, re-runs until stable

steps.name: Create Test Report
steps.description: Compiles manual + automated results into comprehensive report

steps.name: Commit to Git
steps.description: Commits all test artifacts with conventional commit message

steps.name: Audit
steps.description: Role-separated audit pass. Reads all artifacts without trusting the producer. Verifies coverage, no hardcoded secrets, assertion quality, edge cases.

session_continuity.telemetry_format: ndjson (append-only, one JSON object per line per step)
session_continuity.telemetry_warning: TELEMETRY_LOG.ndjson appends every step. Never truncate. Rotate by archiving after 1000 lines.
